Subject: Quick follow-up + next steps from discovery call

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and the team on the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- What we heard: Acme wants predictable inference throughput for customer-facing features, strict data separation, and a short pilot to validate latency & cost.
- Proposed pilot: Dedicated pool for 2 GPU servers, 3-week pilot, integration support.
- Success metrics: p95 latency < 400ms, cost per 1k tokens under target, and no customer-impacting errors.

Next steps:
1) I'll share a one-page pilot plan and an initial SOW. (Target: by EOD Wed 6/3)
2) Jordan — can you confirm procurement/legal contacts so we can route the pilot SOW and standard terms?
3) If you're comfortable, let's lock a technical kickoff for the week of 6/8 — I'm proposing Tue 6/9 at 10am PT.

I've looped Jonas (solutions) and Ben (AE) to support technical & commercial questions. 

Thanks,
Marissa
